question: How are will, knowledge, and action shown to be coextensive in Śiva?
premises: The will has a certain measure.
Knowledge is of the same measure as that will.
Action is of the same measure as that will.
inference: Will, knowledge, and action are mutually coextensive and inseparable.
plain_english: That will is of such extent, knowledge is of such extent, and action is of such extent indeed.
